verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a generic first-party claim that Teams delivers 'chat-based collaboration, meetings, calling, and enterprise voice features' with no specifics on initiating a call from within a channel/DM UI; a community complaint even notes bugs with the 'join call UI being broken/missing.' Missing for 10: first-party documentation/screenshots of the in-context call button in channels/DMs, and independent hands-on confirmation that this works reliably.
